description: A council of seven rule-based agents (Analyst, Guardian, Wash Detector, Signal Master, Momentum, Historian, Valuer) each vote on a token with a confidence and a reason; Guardian and Wash Detector can veto. Returns the consensus verdict, tally and evidence. 0.02 USDC per call via x402.

chain.description: solana, ethereum, base, polygon, arbitrum or bsc

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: council_verdict
